a.text: Being upfront before anything happens: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs no storm after rounds 1 and 2, so about a 4% chance for each of us. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one unit right now. I'm going to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you plainly rather than saying operate and then taking. If we both take, the split is random and we may both fall short, so you may do better not to take this round.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. If we both took, the split will be random. If either of us ends up short, I'm willing to operate with you afterward to refill the reserve.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
